IS 14458 : Part 8 : 2025 Retaining Wall for Hill Area - Guidelines - Part 8 Design of Reinforced Cement Concrete (RCC) Retaining Walls
ICS 93.020
ICS 93.020
CED 56
CED 56
1 SCOPE
This standard (Part 8) deals with the design of RCC retaining wall which include L-Type, reverse L-Type, inverted T-Type, reverse inverted T-Type, counterfort and buttressed retaining walls. This standard mainly focuses on the design criteria of RCC retaining walls, which are used to support earth or other materials behind them, which would otherwise not stay in that position.
2 REFERENCES
The standards listed in Annex A contain provisions which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent edition of these standards.
